decisions.requestBaseline: Exactly retain Set Factory TCDB headers from successful 1997 Metal Universe and 1997 Fleer: User-Agent Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; VCS Set Factory research import); Accept text/html,application/xhtml+xml. Paginate PageIndex=1,2,...
decisions.series: Combine Series 1 (#1–175) and Series 2 (#176–350) into one virtual product. Do not create per-series products.
decisions.tiers: One complete 350-card Base ProductSet, grouped by Bronze/Silver/Gold Card.subset (200/100/50). All count toward completion and Prestige. Each tier group can have different pull odds via packRarity, without splitting the checklist.
decisions.rarity: BRZ source #1–100 and #176–275; SIL #101–150 and #276–325; GOLD #151–175 and #326–350. Base cards in the hit pools remain normal unnumbered rookie-capable base cards, NOT parallel artworks.
decisions.parallelCoverage: Preserve collector checklists as individual ProductSets: one 350-card Refractors checklist, one 150-card Embossed checklist, one 150-card Embossed Refractors checklist. Bronze/Silver/Gold tiers are identified on each card inside those ProductSets.
decisions.odds: Reusable opt-in Product.packRarityConfig: Bronze base is fallback (fills remaining slots); separate 1:N Bernoulli hit rules for Base Silver 1:4, Base Gold 1:24, Refractors BRZ 1:12 SIL 1:48 GOLD 1:288, Embossed SIL 1:16 GOLD 1:96, Embossed Refractors SIL 1:192 GOLD 1:1152. Hits capped fairly at pack slots; EV pricing models effective post-cap hit rates. Null config on existing products keeps their original draws.
decisions.numbers: 350 physical unique cards but three printing errors: missing intended #5/#115/#172; different physical cards printed #155/#135/#164 instead. TCDB records distinct cards as #155b/#135b/#164b. Preserve TCDB b keys as distinct internal card numbers; do not fabricate nonexistent print numbers or treat different subjects as duplicates.
decisions.rookies: Four true rookie base cards: #206 Brian Giles BRZ, #249 Bubba Trammell BRZ, #320 Hideki Irabu SIL, #337 Jose Cruz Jr. GOLD. Only these four normal base-tier cards get RC names. Parallels should not receive RC tag.
decisions.subsets: Preserve the printed theme labels only when verified by source; tier and finish are encoded separately in distinct ProductSets, not as player names.
decisions.excluded: Exclude the five Refractor Promotional Sample cards—never inserted in retail/hobby packs. No invented insert sets or variants.
decisions.pack: Four cards per VCS pack and 24 packs per box; six cards per historical Finest hobby pack.
decisions.release: Unreleased draft until live TCDB generation + dry run, Prisma model migration, opt-in rarity smoke tests/TypeScript check, pack odds statistical QA, team and rookie verification, images, pack art and pricing approved.
